title: Slow gothic tour
text: What an amazing way to discover your lovely city. My husband and I never felt rushed at all. We loved all the sites visited. The tour guide walked the extra mile and even checked for restaurants and museums for us. This is a great to discover the off-the-beaten path sites too. Great job! I will use Icono again.
